short: Cap the contribution using its partner

lean.name: Formalism.MainNotions.G.capU
lean.plain: Cap the contribution using its partner
lean.note: The capacity is the adjusted weight at the partner reached after $e$ Frobenius steps, on the second copy for odd steps in the signal class. It caps the odd-position deduction in $g_U$ and is subtracted before taking the positive part in $g_0$.
